problem_statement: startbootstrap-clean-blog (StartBootstrap) is a runnable static Pug/SCSS Bootstrap 5 editorial blog with a real multi-page structure: a home page whose masthead carries the site wordmark and tagline over a centred column of four post previews (each a headline, optional subtitle, author byline and date, separated by dividers, with an Older Posts pager), a sample article route (post.html) that renders the article title as an H1 with a subheading, byline and a long body broken by section headings and a blockquote, an about route (about.html) and a contact route (contact.html) with a message form, plus a shared navbar and footer. Out of the box every surface renders the generic Clean Blog demo: the home masthead reads 'Clean Blog' / 'A Blog Theme by Start Bootstrap', the four previews are the Space-Ipsum demo essays ('Man must explore, and this is exploration at its greatest', 'I believe every human has a finite number of heartbeats', 'Science has not yet mastered prophecy', 'Failure is not an option') bylined 'Start Bootstrap', the article is the Space-Ipsum sample post, the about page is three Lorem-ipsum paragraphs headed 'About Me', the contact page is headed 'Contact Me', the navbar brand reads 'Start Bootstrap' and the footer credit reads 'Copyright Your Website 2023'. Restyle and rebrand this generic starter into a coherent fictional publication: Tidemark Review, an independent quarterly of coastal and estuary science essays edited by Marlow Renwick. Relabel the home masthead wordmark and tagline and the SEO title to Tidemark Review; rewrite the four post previews into four grounded coastal-science essays with real headlines, subtitles, the Marlow Renwick byline and dates, and point the byline links at the about route; rewrite the sample article (post.html) into the lead essay 'Reading the salt marsh by the height of its grass' with its own subheading, byline, section headings ('Measuring what the grass already knows', 'A ledger written twice a day') and a genuine body about marsh accretion and tide gauges; rewrite the about page into 'About the Review' with Marlow Renwick's editor biography, clearing the Lorem-ipsum; and rebrand the contact page ('Write to the Review'), the navbar brand and the footer credit. Keep the Clean Blog theme, the Pug/SCSS build pipeline, the four routes, the masthead/preview/article/form structure and the local masthead and article images intact, render without meaningful horizontal overflow on desktop, 390px mobile and tablet, and vendor the previously remote CSS/JS (Bootstrap, the icon kit, the web fonts, the form script) locally so the pages render cleanly offline with no console or network errors. On top of the rebrand, add the publication's own reading affordance: a 'Reading room' category filter that sits directly above the four home essay previews. It presents a labelled chip row (All sections / Salt Marsh / Tides / Shorebirds / Fieldwork) and a live readout that reads 'Showing N of 4 essays / <section>'. Tag each of the four essay previews with its section, and wire the chips so that clicking one narrows the visible previews to that section and rewrites the readout to the new count and label (the pre-click readout reads 'Showing 4 of 4 essays / All sections'). Surface the same 'Reading room' filter heading on the about and article routes so the filter reads as a site-wide reading affordance, keep its chip row wrapping without horizontal overflow on 390px mobile and tablet, and keep the chips and previews legible (do not let the chip row or the essay cards overlap into an unreadable pile or lose contrast).
required_content: Relabel the home masthead wordmark and tagline and the SEO title into the Tidemark Review coastal-science publication: a 'Tidemark Review' masthead wordmark with a coastal-and-estuary-science tagline, an SEO title reading 'Tidemark Review' instead of the 'Clean Blog - Start Bootstrap Theme' demo, the navbar brand relabelled to 'Tidemark Review' and the footer credit rewritten from 'Copyright Your Website 2023' to the Tidemark Review credit.

Rewrite the four home post previews into four grounded coastal-science essays (headlines, subtitles, the Marlow Renwick byline and dates) and rewrite the sample article route (post.html) into the lead essay 'Reading the salt marsh by the height of its grass' with its own subheading, byline, section headings and a genuine marsh-accretion body, in place of the Space-Ipsum demo essays and the 'Man must explore' sample post.

Rewrite the about route into 'About the Review' with Marlow Renwick's editor biography and rebrand the contact route to 'Write to the Review', clearing every Clean Blog demo signal (the 'Clean Blog' / 'A Blog Theme by Start Bootstrap' masthead, the 'Man must explore' demo essays, the 'About Me' Lorem-ipsum about page, the 'Contact Me' heading and the 'Your Website' footer) across the home, article, about and contact pages, and vendor the remote CSS/JS locally so no page emits console or network errors offline.

Add a native 'Reading room' category filter above the four home essay previews: a chip row (All sections / Salt Marsh / Tides / Shorebirds / Fieldwork) plus a live 'Showing N of 4 essays / <section>' readout, with each preview tagged by section. Clicking a chip must actually filter the visible previews and update the readout count and label; the 'Reading room' filter heading must also appear on the about and article routes. Keep the chip row wrapping (no horizontal overflow at 390px / tablet) and the chips and essay cards legible and non-overlapping.
design_constraints: Keep the Clean Blog structure unchanged: the home page keeps its masthead wordmark and tagline above the centred column of four post previews separated by dividers with an Older Essays pager, the article page keeps rendering its title as an H1 above a subheading, byline and section-headed body, the about and contact pages keep their masthead-plus-column layout and the contact form, reframing copy within the existing Pug templates and SCSS rather than restructuring the pages, adding dependencies or rewriting the build scripts.

Use a single coherent identity (Tidemark Review, edited by Marlow Renwick) across the masthead wordmark, the tagline, the four post previews and their bylines, the lead article, the about biography, the contact page, the navbar brand, the footer credit and the SEO title.

Replace every Clean Blog demo signal (the 'Clean Blog' / 'A Blog Theme by Start Bootstrap' masthead, the Space-Ipsum demo essays bylined 'Start Bootstrap', the 'Man must explore' sample post, the 'About Me' Lorem-ipsum about page, the 'Contact Me' heading and the 'Copyright Your Website 2023' footer) with the Tidemark Review coastal-science identity, leaving no Clean Blog demo copy behind on the home, article, about or contact pages.

Keep the existing StartBootstrap/Clean Blog visual vocabulary: the centred single-column editorial layout, Bootstrap spacing, the primary accent colour, uppercase button/meta language and the post-preview typography, restyling copy within it rather than turning it into an unrelated card grid or marketing block.

Keep the home, article, about and contact pages rendering within the viewport on desktop, 390px mobile and tablet with no meaningful horizontal overflow, reuse the existing responsive Bootstrap layout, and vendor the previously remote CSS/JS (Bootstrap bundle, the icon kit, the web fonts and the contact-form script) locally so the pages introduce no remote network fetches and render cleanly offline with no console or network errors.

Build the 'Reading room' filter as a real part of the editorial post list, not a bolted-on metric strip: the chip row and readout live in the home main column directly above the four essay previews, reuse the Clean Blog typography and accent, and the same 'Reading room' heading appears on the about and article routes. author_notes: Restyle the startbootstrap-clean-blog generic Clean Blog demo (a 'Clean Blog' / 'A Blog Theme by Start Bootstrap' masthead, the Space-Ipsum demo essays bylined 'Start Bootstrap', the 'Man must explore' sample post, the 'About Me' Lorem-ipsum about page, the 'Contact Me' contact page, a 'Start Bootstrap' navbar brand and a 'Copyright Your Website 2023' footer, loading Bootstrap, an icon kit, the web fonts and the form script from remote CDNs) into Tidemark Review, an independent quarterly of coastal and estuary science essays edited by Marlow Renwick, editing src/pug (index/post/about/contact + navbar/footer includes) and vendoring the remote CSS/JS locally. The reference vendors Bootstrap and the icon kit locally and drops the remote web-font and form-script tags so the console and network stay clean offline; the demo legs keep the remote CDN tags and fail the console gate. The bad solution rebrands only the home masthead wordmark, the navbar brand and the SEO title and leaves the four previews, the article, the about page and the contact page as the Clean Blog demo, so it passes the regression gate on the home masthead but fails completion, visible, forbidden, console and DOM. Also add the publication's native 'Reading room' post-list category filter above the four essay previews (a responsive, mobile-friendly wrapping chip row: All sections / Salt Marsh / Tides / Shorebirds / Fieldwork, with a live 'Showing N of 4 essays' readout), tagging each preview by section and wiring the chips to re-filter the previews and recompute the readout; surface the same filter heading on the about and article routes. Edit src/pug/includes/readingroom.pug, src/scss/sections/_readingroom.scss and src/js/scripts.js for the filter, keeping the local masthead and article images (home-bg.jpg, post-bg.jpg, post-sample-image.jpg) and the existing SVG/icon assets intact and the responsive Bootstrap layout legible on mobile.
